narrative.details:
To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the tauren elders.

I do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha.  I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much.  If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the tauren, it is she.

Magatha resides in the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff, on Elder Rise -- the city's northeastern bluff.  Speak with Magatha, and tell her of the peril of Stonetalon Mountains.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: I bid you greetings. You are here seeking council?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 18 to 23, 9,365 XP in all.

quests.name: Goblin Invaders
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Venture Co. Loggers, then return to Seereth Stonebreak on the border of Stonetalon and the Barrens.

quests.name: The Elder Crone
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Forsaken Aid
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Journey to Tarren Mill
quests.objectiveText: Bring Zamah's Note to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Blood of Innocents
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Vials of Innocent Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Bring Lydon's Toxin to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: The Flying Machine Airport
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Toxic Fogger to the Venture Co.
